templates.name: bdfx_registration_complete
templates.trigger: A new, consenting, phone-verified account was created and still awaits identity verification.
templates.body: Your Billion Dollar FX account registration is complete. Your identity verification is the next step. You can view your verification status in your account.

templates.name: bdfx_verification_reminder_v1
templates.trigger: The consenting, phone-verified account holder still has incomplete verification at dispatch time, after template approval and reminder automation are implemented.
templates.body: Identity verification for your Billion Dollar FX account still needs to be completed. Sign in to your account to continue the required steps or view your latest verification status.

templates.name: bdfx_verification_status_update
templates.trigger: The actual persisted verification state changed; one notification per account and state version, after consent and durable delivery handling are implemented.
templates.body: There is an update to your Billion Dollar FX identity verification. Sign in to your account to view the current status and any required action.

activationRequirements: Use only the verified BDFX tenant 358063 and sender 441157911131; preserve registration OTP and other-company flows.
Recheck each exact template name, language and approval before dispatch. The reminder was submitted on 5 November and remains under Meta review at this checkpoint.
Implement and persist separate optional ongoing WhatsApp account-update consent; OTP and email-marketing consent do not establish it.
Implement a durable idempotent outbox, recheck current account state, consent and verified phone immediately before dispatch, and hold ambiguous sends.
Implement withdrawal handling, including incoming STOP suppression, before enabling automated customer delivery.
Use a consenting test recipient with an explicitly provided country-code phone number, and verify actual delivery before enabling customer automation.
